question:
A parallel plate capacitor has plate area $A$ and separation $d$ in air. Using the expression for its capacitance, explain how the capacitance changes when
(a) the plate area is made three times and
(b) the plate separation is made half. Hence find the final capacitance if the initial capacitance is $6\,\text{pF}$ and both changes are made simultaneously.

options.A: Area tripled makes capacitance three times; separation halved makes it half; final capacitance is $9\,\text{pF}$
options.B: Area tripled makes capacitance half; separation halved makes it three times; final capacitance is $18\,\text{pF}$
options.C: Since $C=\frac{\varepsilon_0A}{d}$, area tripled makes $C$ three times and separation halved makes $C$ twice; together $C'=6C=36\,\text{pF}$
options.D: Area tripled and separation halved both make capacitance three times; final capacitance is $54\,\text{pF}$
